identity_rule: tutorial_id from the tutorial-list API is canonical identity. student_uid+tutorial_ts+tutorial_type is only a reconciliation locator and must never be promoted to identity.
association_rule: Captured summary states remain separate from canonical API identities unless the reconciliation result proves a per-tutorial association. Collision handling must never assign one ambiguous summary column to a specific API tutorial_id merely by list order.

identical_state.definition: A collision group with equal non-zero API and summary counts in which every captured summary state has the same governed state content.
identical_state.revision_rule: Revision by tutorial_id may use the common shared state because all candidate states are equivalent, while retaining shared-identical collision provenance and preserving every canonical tutorial_id separately.

divergent_state.definition: A collision group with equal non-zero API and summary counts and more than one governed summary state.
divergent_state.revision_rule: Revision by tutorial_id is blocked until a proven discriminator associates a specific state with that tutorial_id.

incomplete_evidence.definition: A collision group whose API and summary counts differ or whose candidate summary evidence is absent.

governed_summary_state.reason: URLs and rendering labels locate/describe the captured source entry; they do not distinguish the tutorial's normalized historical content.

timestamp_route_rule: Timestamp-only print/edit route observations are collision-group evidence. They must not be attached to a particular canonical tutorial_id as a discriminator unless a future source proves that association.
legacy_archive_rule: Until D1 persists collision kind and state associations explicitly, any legacy archive row marked collision_ambiguous is not sufficient evidence for revision-by-ID. It must be treated as ambiguous_unknown and fail closed unless separately resolved from governed collision evidence.
